mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (parent_id, level, name, code, description, cover, leader_id, phone, location, intro, sort_order, status, create_time) VALUES ( #{parentId}0, #{level}1, #{name}, #{code}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{leaderId}, #{phone}, #{location}, #{intro}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createTime} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM department WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM department d WHERE d.status = 1 ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC, d.id ASC

SELECT dept_id AS deptId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT d.department_id AS dept_id FROM hospital_doctor d WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.department_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT CAST(jt.dept_id AS UNSIGNED) AS dept_id FROM hospital_doctor d JOIN JSON_TABLE( COALESCE(NULLIF(d.dept_ids, ''), '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (dept_id VARCHAR(20) PATH '$') ) jt WHERE d.status = 1 AND d.dept_ids IS NOT NULL AND d.dept_ids != '' ) t WHERE t.dept_id IS NOT NULL AND t.dept_id != 0 GROUP BY t.dept_id
